entities.name: Ozodbek Nazarbekov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nazarbekov Ozodbek is a well-known Uzbek singer, honored artist of Uzbekistan (2010), and honored artist of Karakalpakstan. He is also the Minister of Culture of Uzbekistan and has been serving as the rector of the Uzbek National Institute of Music Art since 2020.
